title: ἐάν and indefinite relatives
subtitle: Read “whoever” and “whenever” clauses as open situations.
overview: ἐάν can combine with a relative or question word to describe an open or indefinite situation: whoever, whatever, whenever.
Find the relative word, the subjunctive verb, and the main-clause outcome before smoothing the English.

items.grc: ὃς ἂν ὁμολογήσῃ ἐν ἐμοὶ ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὁμολογήσω κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ.
items.en: Whoever confesses me before people, I also will confess him.

items.grc: πᾶν ὃ ἐὰν αἰτῆτε ἐν τῇ προσευχῇ πιστεύετε ὅτι ἐλάβετε.
items.en: Whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you have received it.
